summary: At exact candidate head e07df13d07ff0d388a492f71cfd8cef336b05203, the requested NDHWC input/output API works, matches an independent PyTorch conv3d reference, and eliminates the per-call input transpose for an NDHWC convolution chain. Recommend accepting the candidate for the reported issue.

tests.what_was_measured: Prepared-base public NDHWC API reproduction; failed with TypeError because layout was forwarded to _conv3d_impl.

tests.command: env PYTHONPATH=/job/repo XDG_CACHE_HOME=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b60669aba68b/cache FLYDSL_CACHE_DIR=/tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b60669aba68b/cache /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-b60669aba68b/venv/bin/python -m pytest -q tests/kernels/test_conv3d_implicit.py -k 'layout_contract or ndhwc_chain or ndhwc_splitk' -vv
tests.what_was_measured: Exact candidate regressions: five GPU cases passed for layout conversions, a chained NDHWC path, and split-K.

Independent PyTorch numerical comparisons at rtol=2e-2/atol=2e-2 for unaligned channels, mixed stride/dilation, grouped split-K, unbatched NDHWC, and a two-layer pointwise chain; zero _ncdhw_to_ndhwc calls in the chain.
CUDA profiler kernel events: NCDHW recorded transpose_kernel_0; NDHWC recorded no transpose event.
Complete candidate convolution test module: 62 passed in 159.73 seconds on GPU.
Whitespace/error check of the exact candidate diff.

gpu_execution.evidence: All numerical regressions ran on AMD Instinct MI355X gfx950; full module reported 62 passed, and CUDA profiler output distinguished transpose_kernel_0 on NCDHW from no transpose event on NDHWC.

remaining_limitations: The issue author's MI350X/ROCm 7.1.1 environment, largest production shapes, end-to-end Wan VAE workload, and claimed timing improvement were not reproduced. Testing used MI355X/gfx950 with ROCm 7.2. No native rebuild was needed because the candidate has no C++ changes. Direct upstream issue API access was blocked by the ROCm organization token policy; the supplied snapshot and mirror issue were used.
